steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Did old Wellington send his entire reserve fleet here?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Yes, Your Grace.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: The Duke of Wellington seems to be fighting that ship... he must be sure of his victory.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Their frontline forces must have already exchanged fire with the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Grr, and there's still Caster...

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: That woman has barely ever stepped outside her demesne, but even she's not staying put this time.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Just how valuable is this ship to be worth all their trouble?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Your Grace, the strategists are also recommending we obtain as much technology as we can from that airship.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Whether we stand against the Sarkaz, or... other possible rivals, such an unprecedented weapon will allow us to control an even larger airspace.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Shut them up. What 'possible opponents'? They're inciting me to break up Victoria.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: I came here solely to bring Delphine home.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: They're also saying that Norport Borough may be in terrible shape right now.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Delphine will be fine. She's my daughter after all.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Y-Your Grace...

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Haven't I said before that running inside the ship is forbidden?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Please, take a look at the shadow of that moving plate...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Something's... not quite right...
Duke Windermere takes the telescope offered by the adjutant.
The shadow of the mobile plate cast by the morning sun does not resemble Norport Borough.
Is this because of the structure blocking it? Windermere thinks it strangely resembles a tower.
A tower?
Or... A Shard?

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Is that... The Shard's shadow?

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: How can this be? Is this a natural phenomenon? Or...?

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: How long did you say it would take for Caster's and Wellington's troops to arrive?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Perhaps within the next two hours?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: A rare event indeed, for the troops of three dukes to all coincidentally converge near this area...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: According to reports we received earlier, a few other dukes are also planning their moves, so it would not be too surprising to see their warships on the move here.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: I've been in the army for many years, and yet this is the first time I've seen something like this.

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Full stop! All units, stop immediately!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Get all of them clear of the area at once!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Send a red flare to warn our allies!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Quickly! Now!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Send a plaintext to every Victorian unit in the region!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: This place could well be the target of The Shard's attack!

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: A-Alright!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: Don't turn the ship, speed it up towards Norport Borough!

steps.name: Duke of Windermere
steps.text: I have to find Delphine before the storm comes!
Red flares blossom under the clouds, and the distorted shadows return to their original state.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Impressive work, Ines.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It was going to be a simple test shot, not at our full power, but we have many other locations to choose for next time.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I do have to admit I have some tiny regrets.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But the Military Commission always has more than just a single plan.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Inform the Nachzehrer King, it's time to rouse the troops.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The storm will open a path for him.
Ines often says death is also a tool.
She would sometimes joke to Hoederer that she might be getting a little too used to playing dead.
But now, as she stands on death's door, Ines realizes that she feels calmer than she expected.
She closes her eyes.
A blaze abruptly bakes her face, along with an intense shockwave.
The unique smell of the explosives is well familiar to Ines.
Her lips curl up.
Dust and smoke from the explosion engulfs her with embers still retaining the heat of the flames.
These embers gather, dance, and weave together.
Sarkaz history is woven of embers, but occasionally, other things are knitted from the smoldering remains.
For example...
Ines falls head first into a cushiony cloud of smoke and dust.
A giant web of embers holds her aloft.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I never should've expected... that the two of them could come up with anything better.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, Ines. Still alive and kicking?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That explosion was pretty tough, so don't blame me if any minor issues crop up.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ah man, Hoederer. Let's just bury her.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Sorry to rain on your parade, but I'm still alive for now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh. Killjoy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, did you like the fireworks I set off for you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: And guess what I secretly sewed into your clothes?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wow! Who would've guessed? A tracking device!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do you think I never noticed it?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Shoddy stitching, your darning skills are honestly embarrassing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Grr. That was supposed to be a present for you, but well, I guess this way's fine too.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And these—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't you know how difficult it is to keep clothes clean and tidy on a battlefield?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And you still threw me into a ball of smoldering ashes?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You used to call my Arts embers.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Not in the mood for that now.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're pretty seriously injured.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Better than being dead.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What?! Hoederer! You had Arts to cast all along? I thought you only knew how to chop at guys with your knife!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Embers? No wonder you're so unfazed whenever I throw a bomb at your face!

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, are you not afraid of getting shot?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Can you fling ashes at someone else's face?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is your permanently haggard scowl a side effect of your Arts?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Heh.

steps.name: W
steps.text: How many years has it been since I've seen you in such a pathetic state, Ines?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Believe me, you'll never see me like this again.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't be too confident now, we might just bump into the Sanguinarch having a leisurely stroll on our way back.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W, can I ask you to swap your little hypothetical there?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What, did you develop feelings for those crusty old monsters of the Royal Court after hanging out with Manfred for so long?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, you should be thanking me! If I didn't bump into you scuttling around on my way back, you might've gotten recaptured by your old besties!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe I'll head back to prison so I can at least enjoy some peace and quiet without you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Be my guest, I'll even do you a solid and report you to Theresis.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Where are we headed?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W's safehouse.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Fine, I can force myself to pretend we're going home.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And also—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...I wanna go back.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What's taking her so long today? She injure her leg or something?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We gotta help her out, she'll be so grateful that we're bound to get a few bottles of decent beer out of it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What'cha standing around for? Let's move!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Enough, Hannah! Norport's a sea of flames right now!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Baird's not dumb, she can keep herself safe.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: She's dead.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What're you on about? Morgan, this is no time for a laugh—

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I said! Baird's dead!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Didn't you see that butterfly knife? It was covered in blood!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Baird always kept that on her person, there's no mistaking it...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That knife, in someone else's hand, only means one thing...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I mean, it might be just a misunderstanding. Maybe she lost her knife or something.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: She's got her careless moments too, right? Not like she never lost nuffin before.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Remember that one year when she accidentally lost our carton of eggs? We were supposed to have fried eggs that morning.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Sometimes she slips up, no big deal...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah... McClaren is holding her knife.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Baird went back just to look for him.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He's deaf in both ears, so they probably...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hah! They've been friends for years. You trying to scare me?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Baird probably just lent her knife to McClaren for a bit, nuffin wrong with that, right?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I... I'll go ask him. He can tell us, it was just a...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Where's he? McClaren left Norport along with us, right? So he's definitely in the crowd.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We'll just ask him, this oughta be a misunderstanding...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: McClaren—Where are you—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: McCla—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah, he can't hear you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'll kill the bugger! He's dead! When I find him, I'll smash every single bone in his body!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah! That's enough.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina! Did you already know about this? Bloody hell, why haven't you—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Why haven't I gone and smashed his skull in for Baird?! You think I don't want to?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You think I don't want to?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Because there's no meaning to it! Rubbing out a frightened deaf man makes no bloody sense at all!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah, I hate it, I hate all of this, I'm a fool through and through, a self-righteous twit!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale, Baird...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If I hadn't involved myself in this, they wouldn't have...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What did I even come back for?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What did I even think I came back for?!
Was this... a mistake from the very beginning, born of a false sense of responsibility?
How does she really see them, her friends whom she went through thick and thin and all kinds of hardships with?
Could it be... that this 'friendship' she cherishes so deeply, was actually just an excuse to deceive even herself?
Could it be, that she of all people, has gradually come to see herself as a king?
Grant mercy, sow benevolence... and then, harvest hope and reverence.
What exactly... did she want to achieve here?
What exactly did she expect to achieve here?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, we came back because we couldn't stand it... we were just watching from the side.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Because this is our street, our turf, our country.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You're always charging ahead, but this isn't your responsibility.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We're not following you to see what kind of person you'll become.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, you're just our Vina, right?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm just Vina. This I swear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where should we bring these people from Norport Borough? We can't let them fend for themselves in the wilderness, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides, this is the heart of the battle.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: These townspeople can live on my mother's land, if they're willing to move.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Mother has a nomadic city in the vicinity of Londinium. It's a rather tiny fortress city, but it'll be no problem to accommodate them.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Got any other ideas, Cador?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: You know, Delphine? Ever since you stopped hiding your identity, you've changed the way you speak.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I know what happened with Baird... has upset you.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It upset us all, but right now, there's no need to dampen our spirits even more.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I just...
Ah, finally found you.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Could we please have some water to drink?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: That Draco... we don't like those flames of hers, so difficult to extinguish.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Damazti.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Ascalon... It's been a while, hmm?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: What did you come here for?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We're thirsty.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: And to offer a greeting to the little King of Sarkaz here.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: That banshee speaks pretty highly of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's alright, Doctor. I've never seen our guest here in their current form, but... I know them very well, they've appeared frequently in those histories.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But they're always wandering outside the Royal Court, and they're not interested in anything... except themselves.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Damazti fragment, why have you appeared before us?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: So you really are a genuine King of Sarkaz, little bunny.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: That thing seems to have also tormented you quite a bit. Good job holding all that in your little head while not being a Sarkaz.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Memory is the most precious thing to us, but it can sometimes also be our poison.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: So you see, we do appear to have something to talk about.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you... also of the opinion that I'm not worthy of bearing the crown of 'The King of Sarkaz'?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: I see that talkative revenant really put you through the wringer.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Don't mind it, he's never been the kindly type.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're an ancient Sarkaz, so how do you think... a King should act?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Oh, good question. We've never been one, and we don't care to bother...

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: But we're thinking, you should at the very least be strong enough?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Strong enough to... overcome any hesitation or doubt, yes?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Oh, we're certain of something else though. You definitely shouldn't be asking us this question, little King.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: You have a long path ahead of you, regardless of whether you're leading the organization you call Rhodes Island or following the guidance of the Sarkaz souls.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Oh, sorry. We forgot that the souls won't accept you, just like how they won't accept us.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We're all different from each other.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: However—

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: You'll understand at some point in the future, that the passage of time is unbeatable. The Kings of Sarkaz in our memories, all walked the very same path in the end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I—refuse to walk that path.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Don't be too quick to refute us, Cautus. We did think it was a nice change having a young King of Sarkaz, but it seems like you're still chained to your fate.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Though we're nonetheless full of expectations for you, a non-Sarkaz King...

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: A young King of Sarkaz who is still growing and questioning her own blood...

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: A never before seen King of Sarkaz...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: What are you up to?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We... have no ill intentions.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: King of Sarkaz, we don't dare to claim that we're wiser than you are, and we have nothing to teach you either.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We only wish to extend an invitation, we seek an opportunity to thoroughly understand a 'unique' individual.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Ascalon, you will understand when you've lived as long as we have.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: When something you've never seen before appears right before your eyes, how could you resist reaching out to it?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: O King of Sarkaz, please grant our perennial lives a pleasant surprise.
